title: 第12章 花家人
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
【死绿茶】：[图片jpg.]

    【死绿茶】：怎么办啊姐姐，我都说不出来玩了，爸妈还有哥哥非要带我来奇幻星看水母登基，你不会介意吧！

    【死绿茶】：哦对了，姐姐怎么可能会介意，你从小在荒星长大，估计连水母是什么都没见过。

    【死绿茶】：别灰心姐姐，等我们回来你找爸妈认个错，她们一定会让你回家。你才是爸妈的亲女儿，一家人哪里有隔夜仇。

    花期看完消息翻了个白眼。

    这个死绿茶，一天不挑衅她是过不下去了吧？

    以前在家里挨了她那么多打都还要来挑衅，这个脑子真和她那个蹲局子的妈一模一样。

    【花期】：你是不是腿好了脑子又被门夹了，生怕别人不知道你有那群蠢货的疼爱是不是？

    【花期】：都断绝关系了，你觉得我还会在乎这些所谓的亲情吗？煞笔一个，你应该去拿星际最佳女演员奖，说不定还会得上两票。

    【花期】：哦对了，你可能还当不上演员，文化工作者首先要有文化，你一个连二本大学都考不上要花钱买学历的蠢货，也就只有在花国当个米虫。

    【花期】：哎呀！不小心说到你的痛处上，你亲妈都没智商，你的智商能高到哪里去，不然也不可能被我弄到局子里。

    花期啪啪发完消息，心头舒服了，也不管对方看到消息如何跳脚，直接一键静音做饭去。

    另一边，远在奇幻星的花岁岁看到消息的一瞬间，气得脸色铁青，差点对着消息破口大骂。

    花期的这几条消息，完全是戳在她的心窝子上。

    没有靠自己考上大学，是花岁岁一辈子的痛。

    即使在顶尖的学校就读，还有三个名校老师轮番辅导，她对那些知识却完全像是在看天书。

    她以前觉得没什么，大不了一辈子安心当个米虫啃老。

    可自从花期被找回来，她才感觉到危机和什么是基因遗传。

    一个在荒星生活了十四年的乡巴佬，转入学校的一周就稳稳占据了第一的位置，最后还以优异的成绩考上顶尖大学。

    反观她，从小到大一直倒数第一。

    不管怎么补课，脑机接口也好、记忆加强营养液也罢，她仍旧没考上大学，还是家里花钱才读了大学。

    但那个大学明眼人一看就是花钱买的，和花期的大学一个天一个地。
content_en:
[Dead Green Tea]: [Picture jpg.]

    [Dead Green Tea]: What should I do, sister? I can’t even tell you how to play. My parents and my brother insist on taking me to Fantasy Star to watch the jellyfish ascend the throne. You won’t mind, right?

    [Dead Green Tea]: Oh, by the way, how could my sister mind? You grew up in the desert star, and you probably haven’t even seen a jellyfish.

    [Dead Green Tea]: Don’t be discouraged, sister. When we come back, you can admit your mistake to your parents, and they will definitely let you go home. You are your parents' biological daughter, how can a family have an overnight feud.

    Huaqi rolled her eyes after reading the news.

    This damn green tea, she can't go a day without provoking her, right?

    In the past, she had been beaten so many times at home and still wanted to provoke her. Her mind was exactly the same as that of her mother who was always in trouble.

    [Flower Period]: Is your leg healed but your brain is caught in the door again, are you afraid that others won’t know that you are loved by those idiots?

    [Hua Qi]: We have severed all ties, do you think I will still care about these so-called family ties? Damn it, you should go for the Star Award for Best Actress, maybe you'll get two votes.

    [Flower Period]: Oh, by the way, you may not be an actor yet. Cultural workers must first be educated. You are an idiot who can't even get into a second university and has to spend money to buy a degree. You can only be a mediocre person in the flower country.

    [Flower Period]: Oops! I accidentally mentioned your pain points. Your own mother has no IQ. How high can your IQ be? Otherwise, I wouldn't have been able to get you into trouble.

    After sending the message, Hua Qi felt comfortable. No matter how the other party jumped after seeing the message, he just silently started cooking with one click.

    On the other side, the moment Hua Suisui, who was far away in Fantasy Star, saw the news, her face turned livid with anger and she almost cursed at the news.

    These pieces of news from Hua Qi completely touched her heart.

    Not getting into college on your own will be a lifelong pain.

    Even though she was studying in a top school and had three teachers from prestigious schools taking turns to tutor her, she felt as if she was reading from heaven.

    She used to think it was nothing. At worst, she could live her whole life as a worm eating away at her old age.

    But since the flowering period was found, she felt the crisis and what genetic inheritance was.

    A country bumpkin who had lived in Desolate Star for fourteen years firmly occupied the first position within a week of transferring to school, and was finally admitted to a top university with excellent results.

    On the other hand, she has always been at the bottom of the list since she was a child.

    No matter how much extra classes she took, whether it was brain-computer interface or memory-enhancing nutrient solution, she still failed to get into college. Her family still spent money to go to college.

    But a discerning person can see that that university was bought with money, and it is the same as the university in its flowering period.
